author: Paramount Plus
description:
Freaks and Geeks is full of awkward laughs and heartfelt moments. From Bill (Martin Starr) showing off his questionable dance moves to Sam (John Francis Daley) and Neal (Samm Levine), to Daniel (James Franco) surprising the guys at game night, to risky beer runs and scary hospital scares, these moments capture the highs, lows, and friendships that define the series.
